name: RC-B10-0372/2025 – After § 1 – Am 47
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine, the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
part_text: 1u. Condemns the systematic targeting and killing of Palestinian journalists and media workers; recalls that the killing, intimidation and censorship of journalists constitute grave violations of human rights; calls for an immediate international protection mechanism for journalists operating in Gaza, and demands accountability and sanctions against those responsible for attacks on the press;
